tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
Bidder has to quote rates excluding GST, GST shall be paid separately for the applicable.
The Authority reserves the right to accept or reject any or all tenders without assigning any reasons
Corrigendums / modifications / correction, if any, will be published in the website only. More details should be collected from the office at working hours
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPPP Portal.
All terms and conditions as per tender document

The documents to be furnished by Private veterinary practitioner a) Copies of the degree certificate of any of the recognized universities of India b) Copies of the veterinary council registration certificate of any state or IVC)
The tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e., 2023-24 to 2025-26 Achieved in at least Two financial years a minimum annual financial turnover of Rs.20.00 Lakhs.
